title: 第7章 女仆上任第8章 边境的异动
slug: 落魄贵族千金被迫成为我的女仆
lines: ：就在叶海研究那张改良版蒸汽机图纸的时候，蒂芙尼牵着已经换好衣服的琉璃川千代走了进来。
“蒂芙尼，下次能不能进门之前先敲门。”
叶海没有回头都知道来的是谁。
整个城堡里也就只有蒂芙尼会不敲门直接进他的房间，而且走路还蹦蹦跳跳的。
“略略略~”
蒂芙尼吐了吐舌头，完全没有把叶海的话放在心里，反而是十分欢快的说道：“哥哥，你快看，千代姐姐穿这衣服好好看啊。”
叶海回头看去，琉璃川千代低着头，双手紧握放在身前，显得很局促。
她此时已经换上了一身黑白相间，裙摆带蕾丝花边女仆装。
嗯，黑白女仆装配蕾丝白色过膝袜简直是绝配！
叶海看清后眼睛一亮，琉璃川千代这腿真不错。
虽然这个款式的衣服，叶海早就让人制作了很多套，但实际上除了最开始让几个女仆试了一下衣服外，最后并没有在城堡里推行采用。
一方面是城堡里的女仆实在是不适应这种短裙，在她们看来，这实在是有些羞耻了。
对于她们这些经常要进进出出城堡干活的人来说，实在是不合适，除非是一直待在城堡内部，只是穿给自家的领主大人看。
那她们还是非常乐意试试看能不能勾搭上自家领主的。
另一方面自然是因为这身衣服有些脱产了。
女仆都是要工作的，但凡要工作，无论是扫地还是在厨房里做事，都难免会弄脏衣服
可这些蕾丝花边裙和天鹅绒白色过膝袜一看就非常昂贵。
就算给她们在工作时候穿，她们都舍不得穿。
这就导致叶海虽然搞出了这些衣服，但最终只能扔在一旁吃灰。
如今琉璃川千代来了，他的这些衣服可总算是派上用场了。
对于叶海来说，琉璃川千代的定位就是他的贴身女仆。
这本身就是一个脱产的岗位，她自然不用担心弄脏衣服
更何况就算弄脏了，也有很多套换洗的，这点衣服钱他还是掏得出来的。
他走到琉璃川千代面前，用手指挑起琉璃川千代的下巴，嘴角勾起一丝弧度：“琉璃川，从今天起，你就是我的贴身女仆了。”
“你能明白这个位置的含金量吗？”
琉璃川千代的睫毛微微颤抖了一下：“我明白，枫叶伯爵大人。”
叶海语气有些不满：“你该叫我什么？”
琉璃川千代的眼眸中闪过一丝屈辱，但最终还是低下了高贵的头颅，极其细微地屈膝行了一礼：“主人……”
“这就对了。”
叶海满意的点了点头，用手指轻轻刮了一下琉璃川千代滑腻白皙的脸颊：“很不错，晚上记得提前给我暖好床。”
“这可是你贴身女仆的义务。”
琉璃川千代眼眸中的光亮已经有些暗淡，仿佛认命了一般说道：“明白，主人。”
别误会，这个时代的暖床是真的用身体去暖床。
这年头可没有什么电热毯之类的东西，一旦到了冬天，在被窝里刚钻进去的时候，真的是跟个冷窖一样。
就算屋子里有壁炉，那也对被窝里面的温度帮助不大。
所以，在一些大贵族的家里就诞生了专门暖床这一个职位。
只不过之前的叶海并没有贴身女仆，自然也就没有人给他来暖床。
幸好他身为骑士身强体壮的，倒也不是很怕冷。
content_en:
: While Ye Hai was studying the blueprint of the improved steam engine, Tiffany walked in holding Liulicawa Chiyo who had already changed clothes.
"Tiffany, next time could you please knock before entering?"
Ye Hai knew who was coming without looking back.
Tiffany was the only one in the entire castle who would go directly into his room without knocking, and she would even jump while walking.
"Slightly, slightly, slightly~"
Tiffany stuck out her tongue and didn't take Ye Hai's words to heart at all. Instead, she said happily: "Brother, look, Sister Qianyo looks good in this dress."
Ye Hai looked back and saw Liulicawa Chiyo with her head lowered and her hands clasped in front of her, looking very embarrassed.
She had already changed into a black and white maid outfit with a lace hem.
Well, the black and white maid paired with lace and white knee socks is a perfect match!
Ye Hai's eyes lit up when he saw it clearly. Liulicawa Chiyo's legs were really good.
Although Ye Hai had already had many sets of clothes of this style made, in fact, apart from letting a few maids try on the clothes at the beginning, they were not eventually adopted in the castle.
On the one hand, the maids in the castle are really not used to such short skirts. In their opinion, it is really a bit shameful.
For people like them who often have to go in and out of the castle to work, it is really not suitable, unless they stay inside the castle all the time and only wear it for their lords.
Then they are very willing to try and see if they can hook up with their lord.
On the other hand, it's naturally because the clothes are a bit out of place.
Maids all have to work, and whenever they have to work, whether they are sweeping the floor or working in the kitchen, they will inevitably get their clothes dirty.
But these lace skirts and velvet white knee-high socks looked very expensive at first glance.
Even if it is given to them to wear at work, they would not bear to wear it.
This led to the fact that although Ye Hai produced these clothes, he could only throw them aside to eat ashes.
Now that Chiyo Rurigawa is here, these clothes of his are finally put to use.
For Ye Hai, Liulichuan Chiyo is positioned as his personal maid.
This is a off-duty position in itself, so she doesn't have to worry about getting her clothes dirty.
What's more, even if they get dirty, there are many sets of clothes to change, so he can still afford the money for these clothes.
He walked up to Liulichuan Chiyo, lifted up Liulichuan Chiyo's chin with his fingers, and curved the corner of his mouth: "Liulichuan, from today on, you are my personal maid."
"Can you understand the value of this position?"
Rurigawa Chiyo's eyelashes trembled slightly: "I understand, Lord Maple Leaf."
"Huh?"
Ye Hai sounded a little dissatisfied: "What should you call me?"
There was a flash of humiliation in Rurigawa Chiyo's eyes, but in the end he lowered his noble head and bowed in an extremely subtle manner: "Master..."
"That's right."
Ye Hai nodded with satisfaction and gently scraped Liulicawa Chiyo's smooth and white cheeks with his fingers: "It's very good. Remember to warm my bed in advance at night."
"This is your personal maid's duty."
The light in Rurigawa Chiyo's eyes had dimmed a little, and he said as if he had accepted his fate: "Understood, Master."
Don’t get me wrong, bed warmers in this era really use your body to warm the bed.
There are no such things as electric blankets these days. Once winter comes, when you first get under the quilt, it is really like a cold cellar.
Even if there is a fireplace in the house, it will not help much to keep the temperature inside the bed.
Therefore, the position of bed warmer was born in the homes of some great nobles.
It's just that Ye Hai didn't have a personal maid before, so naturally there was no one to warm his bed.
Fortunately, as a knight, he is strong and not very afraid of the cold.
